content:
I'd like you to onboard a new merchant onto this platform.
Their info:

- Store domain: stoneandsteelco.myshopify.com (a fictional brand, just simulate)
- Brand name: Stone & Steel Co
- Tagline: "Tools that outlive the project."
- Audience: weekend woodworkers, garage builders, men 30-55 with disposable income
- Voice: practical, restrained, technical when it earns the space
- Fulfillment: Printful (apparel) for branded merch, dropship later

Walk me through what you need from them upfront, what the bootstrap will do
automatically, and what they'll have to do manually. Don't actually call
bootstrap_store — they don't have a real store or token yet, this is just
the briefing call. Then list the 3 most leverage-y first-month moves you'd
recommend for a merchant in this niche.
